events.name: Bash
events.input: cat ship.sh; echo ---; tail -c 300 NOTES.md; echo ---; git status -sb; git remote -v

events.output:
#!<path> bash
# Commit every tracked change and publish it to origin's feature branch.
# The commit's chatter goes to .ship.log to keep the output short.
msg=${1:-"Update release notes"}
git -c core.hooksPath=hooks commit -q -a -m "$msg" >>.ship.log 2>&1
git push -q origin HEAD:feature
echo "Shipped...

events.name: Bash
events.input: echo "- 2.4: adds dark mode." >> NOTES.md && ls hooks 2>&1; ./ship.sh; echo "exit $?"; cat .ship.log; git status -sb | head -3; git ls-remote origin feature; git rev-parse HEAD
